title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDT-Margined JASMY Perpetual Contracts and Coin-Margined XMR Perpetual Contracts
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch USDT-margined JASMY perpetual contracts at  2022-04-20 03:30 AM (UTC)  and coin-margined XMR perpetual contracts at  2022-04-21 03:30 AM (UTC) . Please note:  JASMY perpetual contracts are USDT-margined futures contracts that use USDT as collateral. Users will be able to select between 1-25x leverage. XMR perpetual contracts are coin-margined futures contracts that use XMR as collateral. Users will be able to select between 1-20x leverage.
